hero.heading: Have a short conversation about Homeward.
hero.lead: Share what you are looking for, ask questions, and learn whether Homeward or a Circle might be a good fit. About 30 minutes, with no pressure to join anything.

expect.heading: A warm, unhurried conversation.
items: Your confirmation will include the meeting link.
Share as much or as little as you choose.
Ask anything about Homeward, practices, or Circles.
Discover a next step only if it feels right.
expect.not_ready: Not ready to schedule? Tell us you are interested instead.
